[+49 (0)2403 646 0](tel:004924036460) [![Elektrowerk Weisweiler GmbH](http://www2.elektrowerk.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/EWW-logo.png)](https://www.elektrowerk.de/en/) Menu About Us[jonaslykke](https://www.elektrowerk.de/en/author/jonaslykke/)2026-05-08T10:47:25+01:00 # About Us ![](https://www.elektrowerk.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Website-Ueber-uns-Kopie-scaled.jpg "Website About Us Copy") ## **Expertise in Ferroalloys Since 1917** For well over a century, Elektrowerk Weisweiler (EWW) has stood for quality, innovation, and responsibility. Founded in 1917, our company has evolved from a regional producer to a globally leading manufacturer of low-carbon ferrochrome specialties (LC FeCr). At our facility in Eschweiler-Weisweiler near Aachen, approximately 145 employees produce up to 32,000 tons of high-quality ferrochrome annually. Our products are used internationally in the superalloy industry—for example, in aerospace, power generation, the chemical industry, and medical technology. In addition, we supply steel and stainless steel mills, foundries, and forges. ## **Specialized in Customized Solutions** Our strength lies in the production of specialty alloys that are individually tailored to our clients’ requirements. While mass products were once the focus, today we develop high-quality solutions for the most demanding applications—efficiently, precisely, and economically. With our “Analytical Services” division, we additionally offer professional analyses in our in-house laboratory—from material analyses to quality testing. ## **Globally Connected – Locally Rooted** As part of the publicly traded AFARAK Group headquartered in Finland, we benefit from a strong international network. The chrome ores we process come from our own mines in Turkey, ensuring consistently high raw material quality—from extraction to processing. We guarantee transparent processes and responsible practices throughout the entire value chain. **Certifications underscore our high standards for quality and sustainability:** * Quality Management according to ISO 9001 * Energy Management according to DIN EN ISO 50001 * Membership in the Gütegemeinschaft Metallhüttenschlacke e.V. ## **Sustainably Into the Future** We are undergoing an ongoing transformation driven by innovation and sustainability. We continuously invest in energy-efficient technologies, increasingly rely on renewable energy sources, and continuously optimize our production processes. **Our goal is clear:** * Zero-waste production, where no residual materials are generated and all materials are recycled * Creating high-quality products while shaping a sustainable and resource-efficient future AFARAK Elektrowerk Weisweiler GmbH Analytical Service Being the production laboratory of a world-leading manufacturer of low carbon ferrochromium especially for the super alloy industry we at Analytical Services exactly know about the importance of analysis matching special customer requirements. | Since our establishment in 1917, we gain experience related to the analytics of nonferrous metal, additives and foundry products daily. Our business is governed by a large spectrum of inorganic analytics. Our clients expect fast and in the first instance precise answers. We grant this task with skilled employees, continuously growing know-how and our laboratories provided with state-of-the arts analytics. In close cooperation with our clients we solve complex problems and provided a large field of inorganic analytics as service, especially for metallurgy purposes. Our clients are industry, universities and engineering companies and we provide them with a large range of most different services. | | --- | | From analytics of metallic materials and mineral substances, determination of elements in organic matrices to production and educts inspections at metallurgy companies and their suppliers  at our premises the client is provided with a broad analytic spectrum up to trace analysis and determination of environmental parameters. All determinations are realized in compliance with the relevant regulations and standards. We are represented at the chemist board of VDEH, in DIN standard commissions and other task groups and always happy to transfer our knowledge to our customers. Furthermore we participate in the establishment of reference materials that are used worldwide. | | Analytics of raw material, operating supply items, intermediate and final substances are the crucial basis for decisions by production managers in charge, purchase and sales staff, QA specialists and engineers. Only a fast and precise analysis assures quality on a high level and is important for further product development. For routine analysis and further special applications we are provided with stat-of-the art measuring procedures to process even the most difficult problems! We would be pleased to realize neutral sampling on-side and/or sample-preparation of the material to be analyzed for you in compliance with the relevant regulations and standards (DIN, DEV, ISO, etc.). | | To determine proof limits growing smaller and smaller requires competent personnel with experience of many years and state-of-the-art analysis technology. Therefore we are in a position to safely determine the most different elements in solid and liquid substances in a reproducible way. Please contact us – we will be happy to make an offer! AFARAK Elektrowerk Weisweiler GmbH PRODUCTS - Analytical Services - Special Products - Alloying Powders - Ferrochrome | EWW has been gaining daily experience in ferrochrome production since 1917. Today, EWW is a world leader producing special grades of low carbon ferrochrome. The outstanding quality of our ferrochrome is the result of a sophisticated process. This starts with the raw material: chromium ore from group-owned mines in Turkey. The ore is high in chromium and very low in undesirable impurities, enabling us to control the quality of our finished product. | | --- | | Each step in the process is controlled and product quality is monitored by modern laboratory equipment. We continuously improve our production process and work with our customers to develop new specifications to satisfy individual requirements. info@elektrowerk.de |
